description: Adds a view to a Notion database: a table, board, list, calendar, timeline, gallery, form, chart, map or dashboard over one of its data sources, with an optional filter, sorts and layout configuration in Notion's JSON. Returns the view's id, name, type, database_id, data_source_id, url, filter and sorts. The view id is what notion_query_data_source takes as view_id.

account.description: Optional email address of the connected account to use (e.g. 'user@gmail.com'). If omitted, the default account is used.

configuration.description: Notion's view configuration object, sent unchanged; its type matches the view's type (for example a board's group_by).

data_source_id.description: The data source the view shows's Notion id, with or without dashes, or a Notion URL that contains it (the id is read from the URL).

database_id.description: The database's Notion id, with or without dashes, or a Notion URL that contains it (the id is read from the URL).

filter.description: A Notion filter object, sent unchanged, in the form notion_query_data_source takes.

name.description: The view's name, shown on its tab.

sorts.description: A list of Notion sort objects, sent unchanged.

type.description: The view's layout, one of the listed types.

name: notion-mcp__notion_create_view
